own_solution.law: Underdamped series RLC: f_d = sqrt(1/(LC) - (R/2L)^2)/(2 pi).

defect_reasons.other: The question says 'frequency' without naming cycles per second versus angular frequency; the certified Hz answer is the standard reading.

notes: Verified: base 63.662 Hz; C = 47 uF -> 55.765 Hz; 59 uF -> 44.872 Hz; 73 uF -> 34.499 Hz; all remain underdamped (1/LC > 90000 s^-2). Initial charge is an amplitude parameter of a linear ODE and drops out of the frequency (C correct; the authors' cancellation expression is a contrived but valid demonstration). Minimal pairs TBD03/T0F33 and TF60C/TE9E5 share 19 uF and differ only in attachment; TA196 and T4FBC are declared numeral-free controls. Coil resistance not stated as zero is a standard idealisation. Agrees with pass 1.
